purpose: Additive default-6500-K accuracy evidence; no app/core changes or production acceptance claim
domain: finite linear-sRGB Float32 RGB [0,1]^3; HNCS EV=0, CCT=6500 K, legacy/standard
output: display-linear sRGB Float32; encoded metrics use Float32 sRGB OETF with no integer quantization

method.probe_generation: Exact frozen-study RNG call order; 5500 K control independently reproduced against saved metrics
method.interpolation: Existing CPU float32 trilinear oracle; internal R-major/B-fast; exported RGBA R-fast/G-next/B-slowest
method.node_evaluation: Both frozen-study Float32 inverse sRGB and app-style Double inverse sRGB followed by Float32 cast
method.storage: Float32 main result; optional binary16 node rounding promoted to Float32 before CPU interpolation
method.metrics: Max/mean absolute RGB channel; mean and p95/p99 of per-pixel maximum absolute RGB channel; per-channel RMSE. DeltaE76 is CIELAB D65, not DeltaE2000.
method.limitations: Synthetic holdouts, not a formal worst-case bound, photo/camera validation, GPU arithmetic verification, or perceptual acceptance threshold. No Apple execution or device performance claim.
